name: Notion
description: Search your Notion workspace, read pages and databases, and write back to them.
long_description:
Notion's hosted server, connected to the pages you grant it. It searches your workspace, reads pages and database rows, and creates or edits them.

The sign-in happens in your browser and Notion asks which pages to share — that choice is the real permission boundary here, and it is narrower than the connector. Gantry never sees your password.

auth.instructions: Sign in to Notion in your browser and choose what this chat may reach.

risk.notes: Reaches the Notion pages you shared at sign-in. Writes change documents other people read.
